# HMI Daily · 2026-08-21
**① Dual View OLED — one panel, two viewers**
> **EN** LG Display won a CES 2026 Innovation Award for an OLED that feeds driving data to the driver and entertainment to the passenger from a single panel. Its UDC-IR OLED hides the driver-monitoring infrared camera under the screen.
> **中文** LG Display 凭双视角 OLED 斩获 CES 2026 创新奖：同一面板可同时向驾驶员显示行车信息、向乘客播放娱乐内容；UDC-IR OLED 将红外监测摄像头置于屏下，不损画质。
> **한국어** 한 패널로 운전자·동승자에게 서로 다른 화면을 동시 출력. 운전자 모니터링 IR 카메라는 화면 아래 내장해 화질 손실이 없음.

[▸ LG Display Newsroom](https://news.lgdisplay.com/en/2025/11/ces-2026-innovation-awards-the-world-first-automotive-display-solutions-dual-view-oled-and-udc-ir-oled/)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**② QuadAlliance drives holographic windshields to mass production**
> **EN** ZEISS, tesa, Saint-Gobain Sekurit and Hyundai Mobis formed the QuadAlliance to industrialise full-windshield holographic displays — a 1.2L optical engine at over 95% transparency.
> **中文** 蔡司、德莎、圣戈班 Sekurit 与现代摩比斯组建 QuadAlliance，推动整片挡风玻璃全息显示量产：光学引擎约 1.2 升，透光率超 95%。
> **한국어** 윈드실드 전면 홀로그램 HUD 양산을 위한 4사 동맹. 광학엔진 1.2L, 투과율 95% 이상, 운전자·동승자 아이박스 분리.

[▸ PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/zeiss-tesa-saint-gobain-sekurit-and-hyundai-mobis-form-quadalliance-to-accelerate-holographic-windshield-display-mass-production-302674969.html)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**③ VW puts the buttons back**
> **EN** Volkswagen's design chief confirmed physical buttons and knobs are returning, starting with the ID. Polo — "it's a car, not a phone." A direct correction to touch-only interiors.
> **中文** 大众设计负责人确认实体按键与旋钮回归，将从 ID. Polo 开始——「这是车，不是手机。」这是对纯触控内饰的直接修正。
> **한국어** 멀티모달이 확산되는 와중에도 촉각 조작을 되살림. 터치 일변도 UI에 대한 반작용으로, 마이크로모빌리티 HMI에도 시사점이 있음.

[▸ InsideEVs](https://insideevs.com/news/752840/vw-brings-back-buttons-switches/)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**④ AUO spins out AMSC — from panels to whole cockpits**
> **EN** AUO launched AUO Mobility Solutions Corp., bundling displays with climate control and HMI design into system-integrated cockpits, debuting at CES 2026.
> **中文** 友达成立 AUO Mobility Solutions，将显示、空调与 HMI 设计整合为座舱系统方案，并于 CES 2026 亮相。
> **한국어** 패널 공급사에서 콕핏 시스템 통합업체로 전환. 디스플레이+공조+HMI 설계를 묶어 판매하는 구조.

[▸ AUO](https://www.auo.com/en-global/New_Archive/detail/News_Archive_Product_20251118)
